actual: R12P durable run macb_453ca2d0c5b21b40_20240701_20260629_20260724T113329317996Z_47889d7b reproduced a materialization failure when runtime_template_dir is a completed QE workspace containing DrvFS .h5/.parquet reparse points. The existing WSL cp -a path correctly preserves those links, but the durable artifact publisher then traverses every staging entry, dereferences a Windows reparse point through Path.is_dir()/is_file(), and raises NotADirectoryError/WinError 267 before any remote attempt is created. Expected: canonical external QE data links are explicitly recorded as non-published node data bindings, never dereferenced or silently hashed into the durable artifact set; unexpected links fail loud; combine/weight/LOO/backtest semantics remain unchanged.
